Name: (AT) Inherited Farmhouse and Furniture
Author: schmegaman
Description:
Adds a farmhouse inspired by 1940's cottages, as well as a small furniture set. The idea is that, as the name of the mod implies, you've inherited the home (and some mementos) from Grandpa. Your stuff has seen more than a couple decades of use, so it won't be in the best condition. As you upgrade your farmhouse it will start looking less abandoned and more lived-in, as well as some pieces of it being remodeled & redecorated to fit a more contemporary standard. ^_^

I really enjoy more 'realistic' aesthetics but was having a hard time finding any mods that add something similar, especially for buildings. I figured an AT mod was the easiest (and least frustrating) way to dip my toes into SDV modding. :-)

Furniture set includes:
1 painting (uses 'The Muzzomaroo')
1 couch (uses 'BrownCouch') with 3 extra color variants
4 rugs (uses 'BlossomRug')

Update: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35651](AT) Inherited Barn Coop and Shed![/url] More farm buildings on the way ^_^ 

Farmhouse does not have any seasonal variants. That may change in the future though.
[b]REQUIRES Alternative Textures[/b]
